Gustavo,

R does not give the odds ratio, however it can be easily computed by
doing the following: e^coefficient. That is raise e (2.71828) to the
power of the regression coefficient. Example: coefficient = 0.245,
then e^0.245=1.278. So OR = 1.278.

Davester
